dogecoin.text:
End of day 1, down 25% on one stock and down 8% on another. But my @dogecoin is up 9%. 

First day thoughts - Why even buy individual stocks? @dogecoin and @ethereum to the moon.

Beginning of day 2, I'm too impatient. Selling out my stocks and buying @dogecoin. 

Second day thoughts - If I'm going to speculatively buy, it's going to be with the potential for ludicrous returns.
